exposure: Hospital-wide blood management educational campaign (Grand Rounds, formal and informal teaching, posters)
outcome: Total number of RBC units transfused
cohort: The study cohort consisted of all patients who received a red blood cell transfusion while admitted under an Obstetrics and Gynaecology provider in two 12-month periods.
finding: RBC transfusion appropriateness remained low after a hospital-wide educational campaign, however, there was a marked decrease in overall transfusion use, reflecting the adoption of more restrictive transfusion practices.
